title: Reopening the same article renders nothing
acceptance: Opening an article, returning to the library, and opening the SAME article again renders it
testFullScreenEntryIsNotSticky and testPositionRestoreAcrossReopen both pass on a clean install
Opening a different article still works, and scroll-position restore is unaffected
The fix is verified by running the suite, not by reasoning about it
notes: REAL, REPRODUCIBLE, AND USER-FACING. Found by T-0045 (36290df) while establishing a baseline. Two INDEPENDENT tests fail the same way, 4/4 on clean installs: testFullScreenEntryIsNotSticky and testPositionRestoreAcrossReopen. Symptom: after reopening the same post a second time, no TextView ever appears within 15s. Because two different tests reproduce it identically, this is not a test-query problem — it is the app. Reopening an article is a core interaction and it is broken. SUSPECTS, in order: RootView mounts ReaderView inside a Group with .id(post.id), so re-selecting the SAME post may not force the remount that selecting a different one does; T-0049 added preferredCompactColumn wiring on .onChange(of: selectedPost), which may not fire usefully when the value returns to a previous one; and T-0024 made isImmersive default true with an onAppear callback, so a view that is reused rather than rebuilt may never re-run it. Reproduce first with the existing failing tests — they are already written and already fail, so the loop is fast.

history.detail: attempt 1; real user-facing defect found by T-0045's baseline
